leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the create function from Zustand to initialize a store with TypeScript types.
Define a store interface with properties and methods for state management.
Implement the persist middleware by importing and applying it to the store configuration.
Use the persist function to configure storage options including the storage engine and key.
Construct a Zustand store with persist middleware that maintains state across page reloads.
Access store state and methods within React components using the useStore hook.
Modify store state by invoking action methods defined in the store interface.
Control which parts of the store state are persisted by configuring partial persistence options.
Retrieve persisted state from localStorage to rehydrate the store on application initialization.
Compare Zustand's persist middleware approach with manual localStorage implementations.
Handle TypeScript generics when defining the persist configuration for type-safe state persistence.
Return a fully configured Zustand store with persistence capabilities ready for component consumption.
